# Bundled ST-LINK USB driver

- Package: `STSW-LINK009-v3.zip`
- Origin: STM32CubeProgrammer installed STSW-LINK009 driver payload
- Driver version reported by `stlink_dbg_winusb.inf`: `2.02` (2021-04-01)
- SHA-256: `05DD53CE0EDCEC56625E9EA6FD1B979D03A89FEDB1AAEB917454D0EE662BE833`
- Purpose: offline one-click preparation of Windows 10/11 workstations using ST-LINK with STM32 devices.
- License/notice: `SLA0048_STSW-LINK009.txt`

The B300 build pins the archive SHA-256 and refuses a Windows one-click GUI package when the payload is missing or altered.
